references.text: Moses sent spies to explore the land of Canaan, including the mountainous region where the Amorites lived
Earlier in the same chapter, the Lord gives the command to go to the mountain country of the Amorites
God's promise to Abraham that his descendants would receive the land of the Amorites
The Lord promises to lead Israel out of Egypt to a land flowing with milk and honey, where the Amorites live
The spies' report that the Amorites live in the mountain country
Joshua reminds the people how the Lord gave them the land of the Amorites
The Lord gives the land to Israel, not because of their righteousness, but because of the promise made to the fathers
